article.description: How to choose a playground equipment manufacturer in India: what to check on materials, safety, warranty, installation and after-sales support.
article.author: FunPlay Systems Design Team

faq: What should I ask a playground equipment manufacturer before ordering?

Ask whether they make the equipment themselves, what materials and coatings each part uses, which safety standards the designs follow, who installs it, and what the warranty covers in writing. Ask for two or three clients with a similar project that you can call.
Which safety standards apply to playground equipment in India?

Many manufacturers in India design to the European standards EN 1176 for equipment and EN 1177 for impact-absorbing surfacing. Ask the supplier which standard each unit follows and what surface they recommend for its fall height.
Why do playground equipment quotes vary so much?

Quotes often cover different scopes. One may include safety surfacing, transport, installation and GST while another leaves them out. Compare quotes only after listing the same items, models and material specifications side by side.
